executive_summary.key_takeaway: High negative sentiment spike detected for Al-Noor Telecom in Riyadh due to 5G fiber disconnections, while DesertPay's Ramadan cashback campaign achieved highest consumer loyalty.

insights.title: 🚨 Al-Noor Telecom 5G Outage Flare-Up
insights.body: Al-Noor Telecom experienced a 44% spike in negative mentions over the last 72 hours centered in Northern Riyadh (Al-Yasmin district). Sarcastic complaints ('قمة الاحترافية النت فاصل') indicate customer dissatisfaction with chatbot support deflection.
insights.action: Dispatch network engineering teams to inspect Al-Yasmin cell towers; publish an official SLA incident notification to mitigate brand risk.

insights.title: 💡 DesertPay Cashback Campaign Dominance
insights.body: DesertPay generated 78% positive sentiment on TikTok with its 10% instant Ramadan supermarket cashback offer. Share of voice rose to 28% of total GCC fintech discussions.
insights.action: Scale paid influencer partnerships across Saudi & UAE retail creators; extend referral incentives to capture active wallet migrations.

insights.title: ⚠️ Falcon Ride Surge Pricing Friction
insights.body: Falcon Ride faced heightened consumer pushback on weekend surge pricing multipliers (reaching 2.8x base fare in Riyadh Boulevard and Downtown Dubai), driving users toward competing mobility options.
insights.action: Cap maximum surge multipliers during cultural events and review driver commission structures to curb off-platform ride cancellations.
